tasks.label: Check port 5094 lock
args: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5094 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,State,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -in (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5094 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique) } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize
